summary.text: Mistral 7B is the first open model from Mistral AI: a 7.3-billion-parameter language model released on 27 September 2023 with open weights under Apache 2.0, together with a chat fine-tune, Mistral 7B Instruct. Mistral AI highlighted grouped-query attention and sliding window attention; the weights stay on Hugging Face after the model's retirement from Mistral's platform in March 2025.

parameters.note: The docs weights table and the technical report round this to 7B.

notes: First Mistral AI model; no predecessor relation. Released together with the chat fine-tune Mistral 7B Instruct (v0.1), which this record covers as an alias; base and instruct weights are separate Hugging Face repositories. The technical report (arXiv 2310.06825) followed on 2023-10-10. The same-name updates v0.2 and v0.3 are separate records (mistral.mistral-7b-v0-2, mistral.mistral-7b-v0-3). When la Plateforme opened on 2023-12-11 its mistral-tiny endpoint already served v0.2, and no source shows v0.1 on Mistral's API, so access lists only the weights download and the open-mistral-7b id is left to the v0.2 and v0.3 records. The docs page links the legal page https://legal.mistral.ai/ai-governance/models/mistral-7-b, which returns 404.
